note: Files Bivouac can use. The app never downloads anything itself: 'Download' opens the link in the browser, then 'Add downloaded files' links the file in place. min_ram_gb is what Android reports (an '8 GB' phone reports about 7.5).

items.name: Qwen3.5 2B (fast, basic)
items.about: For 4 GB phones. Quick, good for simple lookups; weak on multi-step reasoning.

items.name: Qwen3.5 4B, compact (balanced)
items.about: For 6 GB phones. The 4B in a smaller file: a little less accurate, much better than the 2B.

items.name: Qwen3.5 4B (balanced)
items.about: For 8 GB phones. Nearly as good as the 9B at half the size.

items.name: Qwen3.5 9B (best answers)
items.about: For 12 GB phones. The most accurate, and the slowest.

items.name: Wikipedia (English)
items.about: 6.49M articles (2025-08); full text for the 2M most-read, intro + infobox for the rest.

items.name: Places (worldwide)
items.about: 30M restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, stations, museums and more, for 'near me' questions.
